hypotheses.market_common: Stock negative overnight gap with positive open-to-close repair may reflect common market recovery. If so market gap/repair should distinguish outcomes and absorb the apparent stock-only contrast.
hypotheses.relative_repair: Stock-specific gap and repair relative to market, after strictly prior60session beta adjustment, may retain continuation information beyond ordinary candle and market movement.
hypotheses.continuing_pressure: CompletedT market weakness may forecast later holding losses and help explain the2025 counterexample without using year as a predictor. A contemporaneous future-market attribution alone is not a predictive component.
